Candidate Consent: Use of AI-Assisted Screening Tool (HiredScore) S&P Global requests your consent to use HiredScore, an AI-assisted screening tool, to help evaluate your application. What HiredScore Does: HiredScore compares your resume and application against job posting requirements and generates a grade reflecting how closely your background matches the role. This grade is one factor among many that recruiters consider. It is not the deciding factor, is not a final hiring decision, and does not automatically reject or advance any candidate. A human recruiter is always involved. HiredScore evaluates only job-related information (skills, experience, qualifications) and does not consider protected characteristics. Your Consent: By consenting below, you agree to allow HiredScore to evaluate your application. Consent is voluntary. If you do not consent, your application will be reviewed using the same job-related criteria applied to all candidates. Declining will not disadvantage you. Withdrawal & Accommodations: You may withdraw consent or request an alternative selection process at any time by contacting privacy@spglobal.com. For disability accommodations, Internal candidates can
Are you legally authorized to work in the country to which you are applying?*

Do you, or will you in the future, require sponsorship by S&P Global for an employment visa or immigration related benefit? For purposes of this question, "employment visa or immigration related benefit" includes (but is not limited to) H-1B petitions, sponsorship for OPT extension purposes, TN applications, E-3 visas, and I-140 or Adjustment of Status portability.*
Are you willing to relocate for the position?*
What is your notice period?*
What types of schedules you are willing to work?*
Are any of your personal relations or blood relatives, currently employed by S&P Global? This is not deciding factor*

As part of the recruitment process, you may be invited to complete one or more timed online assessments. We are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive recruitment process. Do you require any accommodations to participate in these assessments, including additional time?*
Do you consent to S&P Global using HiredScore to evaluate your application as described above?*
